rationale: The agent performed an exchange write without a visible, explicit customer confirmation in the conversation; the message says “Thank you for confirming,” but no confirmation step is shown. Authentication is not clearly satisfied beyond a name/ZIP lookup; there’s no explicit verification step or confirmation that the referenced order belongs to the user before acting. The replacement camera changed other specifications (24MP to 30MP), violating the user’s instruction to keep all other specs the same except zoom. The claim of selecting a camera with “maximum zoom capacity” is unsupported—only one product detail call is shown and no comparison or search for maximum zoom is evidenced. The quoted price difference and immediate charge to PayPal are not clearly confirmed with the user before the write. These issues collectively fail the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before order-changing actions, act only on the user’s own order, and provide supported, correct final information.
